thread:
alex: midday rollout check — started canary for feature flag `dyn-routing-v3` at 4% ~11:02 PT. initial traffic looks fine but p50 for long sequences (seq>1024) drifted from ~65ms to ~90ms after the new kv-cache change. not sure if it's cache miss storm or kernel scheduling. pinging infra and ml.

maria: saw the same in dashboards — spike correlates with requests that have long context size. Route counts: sliceA=60%, sliceB=30%, sliceC=10%. sliceC is where the majority of seq>1024 traffic landed.

jordan: thanks. can you dump a quick flame from the runtime? even a line from the agent logs helps.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary start event: feature="dyn-routing-v3", canary_pct=4, commit=7f2a1b, region=us-west-2.

alex: attaching minimal logs snippet from the host (cut):
```
[11:04:12] worker-23 kv_cache: miss streak detected, evicting 12 shards
[11:04:12] runtime: batcher latency p50=12ms p95=110ms p99=230ms
[11:04:13] gpu-rt: kernel_switch wait=18ms
```

samir: curious — we recently changed the eviction threshold to be more aggressive for low-memory nodes. could be thrash. what does memory /gpu utilization look like?

maria: gpu utilization low (~28%), but CPU on the host spiked to ~85% around the same window (busy with cache eviction).

jordan: two quick options: 1) bump canary back to 2% and reroute seq>1024 to fallback model, 2) pause canary and flip a patch to relax eviction threshold. which is lower risk?

alex: leaning toward option 1 (partial rollback) so user traffic affected is minimized while we triage. can we do an emergency slice rule to route seq>1024 to fallback for just canary users?

samir: yes, we can add a rollout policy: if seq_len>1024 AND user_in_canary -> model=fallback-v2. I can push that as a dynamic policy in ~5m.

maria: if you do that, can you also warm the fallback kv-cache? we saw cold-start token penalties earlier.

samir: will pre-warm with warmup requests (400 qps for ~60s) after the policy is live.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Policy update planned by samir at 11:18 PT. Rolling change will not affect prod beyond canary group.

jordan: alex — can you announce to product/pm that we plan temporary routing for long contexts? just a 2-line note so they know UX might be slightly different for canary group.

alex: will do. sending quick note to #product.

maria: one extra ask for post-mortem: capture per-slice seq_len distribution and eviction counts, add to the rollout ticket.

alex: noted. I'll update rollout ticket with links to logs + dashboards after the policy is live. updating status here once done. :thumbsup:

samir: policy live, warming fallback now. monitoring p50 for long seq in canary.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Policy applied successfully. Warmup traffic started (400 qps).

alex: thanks all — will check back in 20m for another status.

maria: thanks, team. :heart:
